title: feat(app-shell): prefill the first organization name from the sign-up e-mail
body:
Fixes #30136

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：云端注册后自动弹出的「创建组织」对话框，名称不再是空的。企业邮箱用域名推出公司名（`jane@acme.com` → `Acme`），公共邮箱（gmail、qq、163 等，代码里的闭合清单）预填现成的「我的组织」/ "My Organization"。名称可改，也可直接点创建；不会自动建组织，只对第一个组织生效。
- 为什么改：objectstack-ai/cloud#3559 裁决 A（预填默认名、一键继续）。公共邮箱的写法按 #30136 上的裁决 6652952865（A：复用 `workspace.default`），不新增文案键，不碰 ADR-0060 冻结的 `workspace` 命名空间。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台对话框的初始值和一个中立的域名工具函数，不改接口与数据；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/emailDomain.ts`（域名规则与公共邮箱清单），以及 `CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx` 里只在打开那一刻取默认值的那段。
- 两分钟验证：用 gmail 账号注册，看到「我的组织」；用 `@acme.com` 账号注册，看到 `Acme`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位复核后落地。

## What changes

- **New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/emailDomain.ts`**: product-neutral helpers named for what they compute: `emailDomain`, `registrableLabel` (multi-part public suffixes such as `acme.co.uk`, `acme.com.cn` → `acme`), `isPublicMailboxDomain` and the closed `PUBLIC_MAILBOX_DOMAINS` list (subdomains included). It decides nothing about what a caller shows, and it is not added to the utils barrel or the package index.
- **`CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx`** keeps only the company-versus-default choice: a work domain gives its registrable label, capitalised (`acme.com` → `Acme`). A public mailbox, or a punycode label, gives `t('workspace.default')`. An address with no domain gives an empty name. The default is read once when the dialog opens, for a user with no organization yet; the field stays editable; nothing is created automatically.
- **No i18n change.** `@object-ui/i18n` is untouched (`workspace.default` already exists in all ten packs). ADR-0060 and `product-specific.allowlist.json` are untouched. The product-neutral ratchet passes.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

- `utils/__tests__/emailDomain.test.ts` (new) covers the domain rule (multi-part suffixes, the generic-TLD control), every entry of the closed list, subdomain and look-alike domains, punycode, and null inputs.
- `CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx` covers a gmail user (en "My Organization", zh 「我的组织」, with one-submit create plus environment provision); an `@acme.com` user (`Acme`); an editable field; empty-name controls; and the name staying put while the organization list moves off zero mid-submit.
- Local readings are in the dev's report on #30136 (comment 6653627193). On the ratchet, the organizations tests, the util test and the i18n parity/vocabulary tests: 22 files / 327 tests passed. `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check passes. One ablation (public-mailbox branch forced off) turns exactly the three public-mailbox cases red.
- The whole app-shell suite runs in CI's 16-shard Test UI.

## Acceptance notes

- Public-mailbox users get the generic 「我的组织」, not 「张三的组织」. This is the accepted cost of ruling 6652952865, which keeps ADR-0060's frozen `workspace` namespace shrink-only.
- ADR-0060 rule 3 says a frozen surface may only shrink. This PR still grows `CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx`, and objectstack-ai/cloud#3559 A (2026-11-04), which names this dialog, is read as authorizing that growth (recorded in 6652952865).
- Hyphenated labels keep their hyphen (`acme-labs.com` → `Acme-labs`); only the first letter is capitalised.
- Not browser-verified against a live cloud stack; the behaviour is pinned at component level with the real en/zh pack values.
- Out of scope, held for the cloud lane: the stale comment in cloud's `packages/service-cloud/src/cloud-stack.ts` (objectstack-ai/cloud#3559's cloud half).

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `7749a01a` derived 35 commands, and all 35 ran with exit 0 (`Run reconciliation — 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`). An earlier `Lint UI` red at `spec check:liveness` (`query/searchFields → packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`) came from main, not this diff (objectstack-ai/objectstack#30367). The seat merged `origin/main` into this branch to pick up that fix.
